room.pick#1.label: LIVE
room.pick#1.text: The run starts with rack R-07 because it is the hottest rack WattNot can act on. WattNot can read and cap the H100s in this rack.

sweep.pick#1.label: LIVE
sweep.pick#1.text: The run will test six power caps from 650 down to 400 watts, trying each one five times. The choices fit inside the allowed range of 200 to 700 watts.
